query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END) as dias_com_faturamento_real,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as total_sem_cat9,
  SUM(cat9) as total_cat9,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) as total_com_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END), 2) as media_diaria_sem_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END) * 3, 2) as projecao_3_dias_sem_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) + (SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END) * 3), 2) as projecao_final_corrigida
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
